what_constrained: Emery boot state and transitional emulator screenshots made visual evidence unreliable until reset and repeated capture.
what_worked: Backing up then wiping the emulator, checking complete native frames, and using a binary-level PBW verifier kept target and visual claims separate.
what_differently: Create a deterministic capture harness before collecting many style variants.

what_constrained: Drawing each prism's depth and front together let later depth strokes cover earlier foreground pixels.
what_worked: An independent pixel-mask review found the defect; drawing all depth before all fronts and comparing fixed native tilt fixtures proved a stable foreground on both watch shapes.
what_differently: Establish an all-segment render order before adding motion or shade passes.

what_constrained: The Emery emulator reverted its forced clock time and later stopped answering screenshot commands after many mode and date checks.
what_worked: Fixed-time fixture renders on both targets established palette legibility; immediate production captures at clock boundaries and persisted palette comparisons verified behavior without relying on a single frame.
what_differently: Use short, isolated emulator sessions for each clock-boundary check and stop once the necessary evidence is captured.

what_constrained: Built-in Pebble text fonts varied greatly in size and too many layered depth copies made some digits hard to read.
what_worked: Two color depth bands kept the foreground legible; subset licensed font resources added distinct choices; fixed-time captures on both watches made decoration comparisons consistent. Fresh review caught a reserved font name before delivery.
what_differently: Build a reusable preview capture script before expanding another option catalog.

what_constrained: A grid color that looked distinct in source quantized to the same black as Tunnel's background on the native watch.
what_worked: Holding time and palette constant exposed 12 distinct patterns on both native targets; additional cross-palette captures revealed and confirmed the Tunnel color fix.
what_differently: Include one native cross-palette check before declaring a new pattern setting independent of existing looks.

what_constrained: Native emulator screenshots can capture a transitional frame with missing date after install.
what_worked: Saved fixed-time before and after captures, inspected both watch shapes, then recaptured settled frames and obtained independent visual review.
what_differently: Wait for the complete date before accepting comparison media.

what_constrained: Centering equal-width digit cells ignored the narrow 1 and the projected depth; 12 bright echoes made the clock crowded.
what_worked: Measured actual native ink bounds, centered foreground plus nominal depth, toned down distant echoes, then verified both target sizes and persistence.
what_differently: Reject transitional emulator screenshots with a date-pixel check before copying into media.

what_constrained: The first amber wireframe and graphite serif captures became crowded at high echo counts; the portal permits only five image assets per platform.
what_worked: Paired native captures at one simulated wrist angle showed direction reversal clearly; lower echo counts improved legibility; one GIF plus four stills filled each platform's asset set.
what_differently: Inspect native contact sheets before selecting final counts and check the portal asset limit before packaging media.
